study.citation: Optimising Spectral Composition in Hydroponic Lettuce Cultivation: The Role of Green Light (Zenodo record 20394352)

source.note: hash recorded by scripts/datasets/acquire.py at download time

Control.Lighting configuration: Eight dimmable Valoya C series 90 W AP 673L LEDs
Control.Crop/sampling notes: Red Batavia lettuce; harvested at 35 DAS

T1.Green-light regime: 24% green throughout the three weeks after transplanting
T1.Lighting configuration: Eight Valoya C series LEDs supplemented with Kroptek Tube KP04 Series LEDs conditioned with light green Roscolene Dinshah filters

T2.Green-light regime: 16% green in week 1, 24% in week 2, 32% in week 3 after transplanting
T2.Lighting configuration: Eight Valoya C series LEDs supplemented with increasing numbers of filtered Kroptek Tube KP04 Series LEDs

T3.Description: Incrementally increasing green spectrum at higher planting density
T3.Green-light regime: 16% green in week 1, 24% in week 2, 32% in week 3 after transplanting
T3.Lighting configuration: Same incremental lighting regime as T2, applied at 25% greater planting density

note: spectral composition is the only manipulated factor, so this table constrains a spectrum effect and says nothing about light intensity.
